versions.subject: Add lsa-server
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 300 
    TargetUserSid|startswith: 'S-1-5-21-' # normal user
    SidList|contains:
        - 'S-1-5-32-544'    # Local admin
        - '-500}'           # doamin admin
        - '-518}'           # Shema admin
        - '-519}'           # enterprise admin
filter_admin:
    TargetUserSid|endswith:
        - '-500'           # domain admin
        - '-518'           # Shema admin
        - '-519'           # enterprise admin
condition: selection and not filter_admin
